text:
The text contains the following word structures:

1. Biodegradable
   - Prefix: Bio- (relating to life or living organisms)
   - Root: degrade (to break down)
   - Suffix: -able (capable of being)

2. Materials
   - Root: material
   - Suffix: -s (plural marker)

3. Break down
   - Root: break
   - Root: down (particle indicating direction or completion)

4. Naturally
   - Root: natural
   - Suffix: -ly (adverbial suffix)

5. Environment
   - Root: environ
   - Suffix: -ment (noun-forming suffix)

6. Relates
   - Root: relate
   - Suffix: -s (third-person singular present tense marker)

7. Organisms
   - Root: organism
   - Suffix: -s (plural marker)

8. Means
   - Root: mean
   - Suffix: -s (third-person singular present tense marker)

9. Remind
   - Prefix: re- (again, in this context, it functions as part of the verb meaning to cause to remember)
   - Root: mind

10. Monday
    - Root: Mon (short for Moon)
    - Suffix: -day (day of the week)
